evidence_level: Production host adapter regressions use authored local repositories and bounded helpers. Process-group observations do not prove closure of all descendants. No container, provider or model acceptance is established.
additional_groups: A foreign index writer at candidate-tree creation cannot enter the checked immutable tree or produce a successful worker receipt.
A foreign shared-index writer after candidate validation cannot alter the private commit index.
An enabled hook launches a bounded detached helper in a new POSIX session. Host execution retains ownership and cannot report worker_commit_ready, including resume after the helper exits.
A missing host commit result cannot be reconciled from an empty original process group into whole-family closure.
Historical workflow controls may use an explicit fixture assumption for closure. Those controls test workflow and Git attribution, not actual containment.
